ObjectName.value: This charming store specializes in Christmas decorations! (27896019765)

Categories.value: Just Christmas|Shop windows in Ontario|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|2015 in Niagara-on-the-Lake|Photographs by shankar s.|November 2015 in Ontario|Photographs of the national flag of Canada in Niagara-on-the-Lake|National flag duos|Flickr images missing SDC published in

ImageDescription.value: We had made a pit stop in Niagara on the Lake where our guide had told us to go look for some breakfast for those who were interested. While setting us down, he had mentioned about a store called Just Christmas, which sells nothing else by Christmas decorations all the year round. Pictures of the store interior appear immediately after this, but I was wondering how they sustain their business for the rest of the year when demand is sure to be low! The probably depend on tourists and those passing through. (Niagara on the Lake, Ontario, Canada. Nov. 2015)
